subject: Vendor onboarding: DPA, SOC 2 link and PO / invoicing path
messages:
From: Samantha Porter <samantha.porter@wavefront.io>
To: jordan.blake@redwood.ai, procurement@wavefront.io
Date: Mon, 17 Aug 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Redwood onboarding checklist (DPA + SOC2 + subprocessor list)

Hi Jordan / Redwood team,

Thanks for the demo last week — Wavefront is ready to move from POC -> production for our payer analytics feature. Procurement has a short onboarding checklist for information security before we issue a PO. Can you send:

- A copy of your standard DPA (PDF or DocuSign link)
- A publicly accessible SOC 2 report or a link to download the report (if available)
- A current subprocessor list (we need names + locations + subprocessed data type)
- PO and invoicing instructions (remit address, billing contact, tax info)

Goal is to get governance sign-off and kick off PO creation this week. If there are any non-standard clauses (data residency, retention, encryption at rest) that we should be aware of, please flag them.

Thanks — Samantha
Samantha Porter
Senior Procurement Manager, Wavefront Health
S: 415-555-0187

Attachment: none

From: jordan.blake@redwood.ai
To: Samantha Porter <samantha.porter@wavefront.io>
Cc: laura_bennett@redwood.ai, ben_carter@redwood.ai
Date: Mon, 17 Aug 2026 10:02:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Redwood onboarding checklist (DPA + SOC2 + subprocessor list)

Samantha — thanks for the clear checklist. Copying Laura (Legal) and Ben (Finance) so we can close the loop quickly. Summary / next steps below.

What I attached / linked:
- Redwood_DPA_v1.2.pdf (attached) — our standard Data Processing Addendum; accepts DocuSign e-sign or countersign on PDF.
- SOC2 report (public link provided below) — we publish an annual SOC 2 type II; the link provides a read-only report and the control matrix.
- Subprocessor snapshot (see summary in email body) — full CSV available on request; includes names, primary region, and processed data categories.
- PO & invoicing instructions (attached PDF) — includes remit address and billing code for Redwood hosted services.

Quick notes on the items you asked to call out:
- Data residency: we support region pinning for Dedicated/Private customers; hosted accounts are covered under our DPA which allows cross-border subprocessors with SCCs.
- Retention: retention periods are driven by customer config; the DPA includes default retention terms and a pathway for tighter retention via contract addendum.
- Encryption: data is encrypted at rest and in transit; see section 3.1 in the DPA.

Action items (I will):
1) Share the signed DPA via DocuSign if Wavefront prefers e-sign.
2) Laura to confirm whether Wavefront's security team needs a supplemental control questionnaire (we can provide an abbreviated version).
3) Ben to confirm PO number format so our billing team can match invoices.

If that timeline works, we can expect PO issuance by Wed/Thu and start invoicing for committed capacity once PO is live.

Thanks — Jordan
Jordan Blake
Enterprise Sales, Redwood Inference
T: 646-555-0212

Attachments: Redwood_DPA_v1.2.pdf (PDF), Wavefront_PO_Instructions.pdf (PDF)

> On Mon, 17 Aug 2026 at 09:12, Samantha Porter <samantha.porter@wavefront.io> wrote:
> > Thanks for the demo last week — Wavefront is ready to move from POC -> production...

From: Samantha Porter <samantha.porter@wavefront.io>
To: jordan.blake@redwood.ai
Cc: procurement@wavefront.io
Date: Tue, 18 Aug 2026 08:40:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Redwood onboarding checklist (DPA + SOC2 + subprocessor list)

Jordan / team — appreciate the quick response. A couple follow-ups from our security reviewer:

1) Can you confirm whether any subprocessor is located in APAC (outside US/EU)? If so, our legal will want a country-level mapping.
2) For the SOC 2 report link you shared, is there a signed attestation PDF we can download? The procurement portal prefers a stamped PDF.
3) Regarding PII retention: our default requirement is 6 months for trial data; can you confirm whether the retention addendum is a redlineable clause or a separate SOW?

We'd like to include these answers in the governance packet before we route the PO. If you can send the subproc CSV and the SOC2 stamped PDF by EOD, we should be ready to issue the PO tomorrow.

Thanks — Sam

Attachment: subproc_template_requested.csv

From: laura_bennett@redwood.ai
To: Samantha Porter <samantha.porter@wavefront.io>, jordan.blake@redwood.ai
Cc: ben_carter@redwood.ai
Date: Wed, 19 Aug 2026 14:45:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Redwood onboarding checklist (DPA + SOC2 + subprocessor list)

Hi Sam — Laura from Legal here. Delivering the items you asked for and confirming contract flex:

- Attached: Redwood_DPA_v1.2_signed_stub.pdf (we attach a signed stub while DocuSign completes), SOC2_report_2026_redwood_signed.pdf (stamped attestation), subprocessor_snapshot_20260819.csv (includes vendor, country, data types).
- Subprocessor APAC presence: yes — two subprocessors have nodes in APAC (Singapore, Sydney). The CSV includes country columns.
- Retention: the retention addendum can be surfaced as a short redlineable addendum to the DPA. For your use case (6 months), we can produce a one-paragraph addendum and route for signature the same day.

PO details: Ben — please confirm that Redwood's billing team will accept Wavefront PO format. Jordan, I left a note in the PO instructions PDF about the billing contact and required PO reference.

Next steps:
- Sam: confirm whether you want DocuSign or signed PDF copy of the DPA + addendum.
- Ben: confirm PO matching code and expected invoice cadence (monthly vs. quarterly).

Happy to hop on a 15-minute call if that speeds this up.

Best,
Laura Bennett
Senior Counsel, Redwood Inference
laura.bennett@redwood.ai

Attachments: Redwood_DPA_v1.2_signed_stub.pdf, SOC2_report_2026_redwood_signed.pdf, subprocessor_snapshot_20260819.csv
